spans.s:
शत् शात॑यति शात॑य˚ते cut in pieces, cause to fall
off, break or throw down, destroy. — अप hurl away. व्यव scatter,
dispense, remove. नि hew down, defeat (an army). प्र break, pluck.
वि hew down, crush, disperse, chase away. सम् crush, destroy.
स॑त् v. स॑न्त्.

शत॑ n. (m.) hundred, also as expression of a large or
infinite number (adj. f. —˚).

1 शात a. sharpened, whetted;
 thin, slender.
2 शात m. the falling out (of hair, nails etc.).
स॑त m. n. a cert. vessel or dish.
सत्त॑ a. sitting, seated.
सत्ता f. existence, being.

सात॑ a. gained, acquired;
 m. N. of a Yaksha.

शतक f. शतिका consisting of hundred or the hundredth;
n. a hundred.

शतकुम्भ m. N. of a mountain;
 f. आ N. of a river.

शातकुम्भ n. gold (lit. coming from the river
Śatakumbhā).
शतकृत्वस् adv. a hundred times.

शतकोटि m. Indra's thunderbolt (lit. having a hundred
edges).

शत॑क्रतु a. having a hundred forces;
 m. E. of Indra.
शतगु a. possessed of a hundred cows.
शतगुण a. hundredfold.
शत˚गुणित a. hundredfold.
शतग्वि॑न् a. = prec.
शतघण्टा f. N. of a spear.
शतघ्नी॑ v. शतह॑न्.
शत॑चक्र a. having a hundred wheels.
शतचर्मन् a. made of a hundred skins.
शततम॑ f. आ॑ & ई a. the hundredth.
शतद a. giving a hundred.
शत॑दा a. giving a hundred.

शतदण्ड s. a fine of one hundred, ˚ण्डार्ह a. worthy
of such a fine.
शत॑दन्त् a. having a hundred teeth (comb).
शतदल n. = शत॑पत्त्र n.
शत॑दातु a. hundredfold.
शत॑दाय a. giving a hundred.
शतदाय॑ a. giving a hundred.
शतदा॑वन् a. = prec.
शत॑द्युम्न m. a man's name.
शतद्रु f. N. of a river.
शत˚द्रू f. N. of a river.
शतद्वार a. hundred-gated.
शतधन्य॑ a. worth a hundred.
शतधा॑ adv. in a hundred parts or ways.
शत॑नीथ a. having a hundred arts or stratagems.
शत॑पति m. lord of a hundred.

शत॑पद् (शत॑˚पाद्), f. शतपदी a. having a hundred
feet.
शत॑पर्वन् a. having a hundred knots or joints.

शतबलि m. a cert. fish;
 N. of a monkey.
शतभाग m. the hundredth part.
शतभुजि a. hundredfold.
शतमख m. = शतयज्ञ.
शत॑मन्यु a. having hundredfold wrath.
शत॑मूति a. granting a hundred aids.
†शतमूर्धन् a. having a hundred heads.
शत॑मूल a. having a hundred roots.

शतयज्ञ m. E. of Indra (lit. receiving a hundred
sacrifice.)

*शतयष्टिक m. a necklace consisting of a hundred
strings.
शतरात्र m. n. a festival of a hundred days (nights).

शत॑वन्त् a. containing or possessing a hundred,
hundredfold.
शतवर्ष a. a hundred years old.
शत˚वर्षिन् a. a hundred years old.
शत॑वाज a. giving a hundred forces.
शत॑विचक्षण a. having a hundredfold appearance.
शत॑वीर्य a. containing a hundred forces.
शतश॑स् adv. by hundreds or hundredfoldly.
शतशाख f. आ & ई having a hundred branches.

शत॑शीर्षन् a. having a hundred heads.
शतसंख्य a. numbering a hundred.

शतसहस्रधा adv. in a hundred thousand pieces.

शतसे॑य n. hundredfold gain.
शतस्वि॑न् a. possessed of a hundred.

 f. आ lightning.
शातह्रद a. of lightning.
शताङ्ग a. hundredfold (lit. -limbed).
शता॑त्मन् a. having or granting a hundred lives.
शताधिक a. hundred and one (lit. more than a hundred).
शता॑नीक a. having a hundred fronts or points.
शताब्द a. consisting of a hundred years.

शता॑यु a. lasting for a hundred years or hundred years
old.
शता॑युध a. having a hundred weapons.
शता॑युस् f. शतायुषी = शता॑यु.

शतेश m. the lord of a hundred (villages).
शतो॑ति a. granting hundredfold help.
शतोदर a. having a hundred bellies (Śiva).
शातोदर f. ई thin-bellied, abstr. ˚त्व n.
शतौदना f. a cert. ceremony.
शत्य a. consisting of a hundred.
सात्य॑ a. whose nature is truth.
श॑त्रि m. N. of a man.

श॑त्रु m. rival, adversary, enemy, esp. the immediate
neighbour of a prince as his natural enemy.

शत्रुघ्न a. slaying foes;
 m. a man's name.
शत्रुजित् a. conquering foes.

शत्रुतू॑र्य n. overcoming foes.

शत्रुंतप^1 a. tormenting foes.

शत्रुमर्दन a. crushing foes.
शत्रुसाह a. overwhelming foes.
शत्रुसेविन् a. serving an enemy.
शत्रुह॑ a. = शत्रुघ्न adj.
शत्रुह॑न् a. = शत्रुघ्न adj.
शत्रूय् pp. शत्रूय॑न्त् be hostile.
शत्रूष॑ह् (शत्रू˚षा॑ह्) a. overwhelming foes.

शातकौम्भ (f. ई) & ˚कौम्भमय a. = prec.

शातन a. (f. ई) & n. causing to fall, cutting off,
destroying.

शात्रव a. inimical;
 m. enemy.
षत्व n. the transition of स into ष (g.).
सततगत m. the wind (lit. = ˚यायिन्)
सतत˚गति m. the wind (lit. = ˚यायिन्)
सततधृति a. showing a constant will.
सततयायिन् a. ever-moving.
सततयुक्त a. constantly devoted.
सत॑ति a. coherent, uninterrupted.
स॑तनु a. embodied, along with the body.
सत॑स् adv. equally.
1 सतीन॑ (—˚) truly, really.
2 सतीन॑ m. a kind of pease.

*सतीर्थ m. fellow-student (lit. having the same
teacher).

सतीर्थ्य m. fellow-student (lit. having the same
teacher).

सतूर्य a. accompanied by music;
 n. adv.

सतृण a. grassy;
 ˚— & n. adv. along with grass.

सतृणाभ्यवहारिन् a. eating all, even grass,
i.e. making no difference, uncritical, insipid (poet).
सतृष्णम् adv. with desire, impatiently.
स॑तेजस् a. along with fire, splendour, or power.

स॑तोक^1 a. along with the offspring.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: alph. order, cf mw,pw.
सतो॑मघवन् a. equally liberal.

सतो॑महन्त्^1 a. equally great.

सतो॑वीर a. equally heroic or valiant.
सत्कथा f. a fine story.

सत्करण n. the cremation of a dead body (lit. good
action).
सत्कर्तव्य a. to be treated well.
सत्कर्तृ m. benefactor.
1 सत्कर्मन् n. a good action.
2 सत्कर्मन् a. doing good actions.

सत्कवि m. a good or true poet;
 abstr. ˚त्व n.

1 सत्कीर्ति f. a good renown.
2 सत्कीर्ति a. having a good renown.
1 सत्कुल n. a good or noble race.
2 सत्कुल a. sprung from a noble race.
सत्कुलीन a. = prec. 2.

सत्कृ make good, put in order, arrange, prepare, adorn,
receive kindly (esp. a guest), treat well, honour (esp. the dead by
burning). — अभि = S. प्रति honour in return.
सत्कृति f. = सत्कार.
सत्क्षेत्र n. a good field.

स॑त्तम (superl.) the best, first among or chief (gen. or
—˚).

सत्त्रराज् m. king of the Sattra (cf. prec.).
सत्त्रस॑द् m. Sattra-fellow.

सत्त्रायण॑ n. a sacrificial session lasting several

सत्त्रिन् m. the performer or partaker of a sacrificial

सत्त्रीय a. belonging to a Sattra.
सत्त्वकर्तृ m. creator of beings.

सत्त्वधामन् n. the splendour of goodness (ph.);

सत्त्वराशि m. a paragon (lit. heap) of firmness or
courage.

सत्त्वलक्षणा f. pregnant, with child, lit. marked
by a (new) being.
सत्त्वशब्द m. a concrete, lit. word for a being (g.).
सत्त्वोत्कर्ष m. extraordinary generosity.

स॑त्पति m. strong chief or hero;
 good lord or husband.
1 सत्पुत्र m. a good son.
2 सत्पुत्र a. having a good son.
सत्पुरुष m. a good or excellent man.
सत्प्रतिग्रह m. acceptance of a gift from good men.

2 †सत्यकर्मन् a. practising truth.

सत्य॑काम a. loving truth;
 m. a man's name.
सत्यगिर् a. whose word is true.

 earnest-money.
सत्यजि॑त् a. truly conquering.
सत्यजिति f. a true victory.
सत्यज्ञ a. knowing truth.

abstr. ˚मता f.
सत्यपराक्रम a. of true valour or power.

सत्य॑प्रस˚वस् a. whose impulse is true or right.
सत्यभामा f. N. of a wife of Kṛṣṇa.
सत्यभाषण n. truth-speaking.
सत्यभू॑य n. the being true, truth.

सत्यय॑ज् a. worshipping truly or successfully.

सत्य॑योनि a. having a firm abode.

सत्यवचन n. & a. truth-speaking.

सत्यवाचक a. = prec. adj.

 m. a man's name.

सत्वचस् a. the same.
स॑त्वन् m. hero, warrior.
सत्वन॑ m. hero, warrior.

सत्वर a. hastening, quick;
 n. adv.
सत्संग m. intercourse with good people.
सत्संगति f. ˚संविधान n. the same.
सातत्य n. continuity, uninterruptedness.
सातवाह m. N. of a king.
